posts.zh:
dsh-telegram-channel 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。Telegram 手机遥控器：附着本机正在跑的 Web 会话，支持 /sessions 工作区→会话选择、/last 查看上次问答、/model 切换模型，以及原生 Rich Message 回复。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-d5f53f55fc4ad87c5231.html
posts.en:
dsh-telegram-channel is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Telegram mobile remote that attaches the phone to a live DeepSeek Harness Web session: workspace-then-session picker (/sessions), /last for the previous Q/A, /model switch, and native Rich Message replies.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-d5f53f55fc4ad87c5231.html
